entity.summary: Lithuania-registered centralized cryptocurrency exchange offering spot trading, token listings, launchpad services, card purchases, and public trading APIs under the P2B brand.
entity.notes: Current first-party pages expose live markets, trading, listings, launchpad, card purchases, and API access. Current independent market data lists recently updated spot pairs, substantial non-zero volume, reserves, and Lithuania registration. The historical P2PB2B domain and current P2B brand remain one entity. Confidence remains medium because first-party corporate and establishment-year statements are less specific than the independent exchange profile. No unsupported exact launch date, predecessor, successor, terminal state, or incident event is asserted.
